description: Attach a link to a task in the connected LoopGantt ACCOUNT (requires a LoopGantt API key): the GitHub PR, Jira or Linear issue, Google Doc, Figma file or Slack thread the work lives in, so people and other agents can follow it and find the task again with find_by_link. A GitHub PR/issue link also shows its open/merged/closed status when the workspace has the GitHub integration. Linking a URL the task already has just returns it (and updates the title if you give one).
name: link_external
